about: Style test, round two (owner, 2026-10-14): the owner's starred styles (techno-vistas, fork-night, new-screen-print) on four more frames. Frame subjects are model-drafted test prompts, labelled, never published; style prompts are round one's; no artist or studio is named. FLUX.2 [klein] with the character sheets as references, to lock the faces.

style.prompt: Detailed science fiction comic art: precise fine uniform linework, rich mechanical and architectural detail kept to the middle and far distance, vast airy compositions with big pastel skies and enormous elegant megastructures on the horizon, cel-shaded flat color with soft hard-edged shadows, clean and bright and hopeful, cinematic wide-angle perspective, no text, no lettering, no writing, no logos, no numbers.

jobs.prompt: Three eighteen-year-olds stand together in a bright corridor outside a game hall just after a match: on the left the tall pale young man smiles, relaxed; in the middle the slim spiky-haired young man grins and talks with his hands; on the right the young woman folds her arms, unimpressed. Medium shot at eye level.

jobs.prompt: At a small table in an open-air courtyard cafe, two young men lean over a glowing menu screen held up by a little wheeled serving robot; the spiky-haired one stares at it in wonder, the tall pale one looks on, curious. The screen shows only abstract glowing shapes. Medium close shot. The place: a small open-air courtyard cafe enclosed by low, dense shop buildings, with scattered small tables and stools beneath a shade tree and strings of little lights, a playful cartoon animal mural on one wall, glowing blank shop panels in pink and cyan, a little wheeled serving robot with a screen face, and an open entrance onto a busy street with a lamp post.
